card.name: Inside rare medical words
card.fires_on: Partway through rare medical words, mainly the 'n' in Oligohydramnios and 'rogen' in iatrogenic. Also fires on 'barbar' in barbarous.

modes.label: Oligohydramnios
modes.description: The 'n' piece inside Oligohydramnios in the fetal toxicity warning about ductus arteriosus closure.

modes.label: Iatrogenic
modes.description: The 'rogen' piece inside iatrogenic before 'ic' in overdose or poisoning text.

modes.label: Barbarous
modes.description: The 'barbar' piece in barbarous in a human rights text.
modes.example: have resulted in<< barbar>>ous acts which have outraged the conscience of

card.writes: The promoted and suppressed tokens look unrelated, so there is no clear output effect.
card.plain: It fires in the middle of a few rare, long words that the model must finish, such as Oligohydramnios and iatrogenic.
